This transition softens your fiery element, making late-week social interactions much more harmonious. Expect a surge of creative passion by Saturday as the Moon enters your 1st House. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance. Monday is your toughest day due to that Pluto square. Harness your fire without burning bridges. Follow for daily updates.
